title: ui cannot install a @codesweep-ai version that exists only as an image
foundBy: user choice (host), answering how a build left off npm reaches ui: "Do (1) publish past ledger, and (2) as well, add with-npmrevs to ui."
details: A repin moves ui's pins on lint, ledger and npmrevs to the last commit each one built. That build can exist only as a container image when npm skipped it, and plain `npm install` cannot fetch one. The tracer, campaign and dashboards projects install through `scripts/with-npmrevs.sh`, which puts cs-npmrevs in front of npmjs.com. A repin holds such a pin in a project without the script.
